import html # Predefined HTML template for a forum post. # The placeholders {poster}, {heading}, {body}, and {labels} will be replaced # by the sanitized values passed to create_forum_post. USER_POST_FORMAT: str = """

{heading}

Posted by: {poster}

{body}
{labels}
""" def create_forum_post(poster: str, heading: str, body: str, labels: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate an HTML representation of a forum post. Args: poster: The author of the post. heading: The title of the user's post. body: The main content of the user's post. labels: A list of tags associated with the post. Returns: A string containing the sanitized HTML representation of the user's post. """ # Sanitize all user supplied strings to prevent injection safe_poster = html.escape(poster, quote=True) safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=False) # Convert the list of tags into elements, each tag is escaped. safe_labels = " ".join( f'{html.escape(label, quote=True)}' for label in labels ) # Format the final HTML using the predefined template. return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( poster=safe_poster, heading=safe_heading, body=safe_body, labels=safe_labels )
